Name: (Outdated) Bathroom Replaces Spouse Room
Author: naeldeus
Description:
the default spouse rooms do not match the rest of my house at all, so i made these bathrooms to replace them! currently, they are for aesthethic purposes only.

[center][color=#ffffff][url=https://ko-fi.com/naeldeus]consider buying me a coffee if you enjoy my mods and wish to support me![/url]﻿[/color][/center]

[b]features:
[/b]
[list]
[*]spouse room replacer with three different bathrooms themes to choose from
[*]a witchy bathroom, a brown themed one, and a white themed one
[/list]

[b]installation:
[/b]
[list]
[*]download and install the latest version of PyTK and TMXLoader
[*]drop the content of this zip file in your Mods[i] [/i]folder
[*]by default, the bacholerettes get the white bathroom, the bachelors the brown one, and abigail gets the witchy one
[*]if you wish to reassign bathrooms, open up content.json to specify whose room you wish to replace and to give what bathroom
[*]for example, search for your spouse's name and change [i]"file": "Brown.tmx"[/i] to [i]"file": Witchy.tmx"  [/i]on the next line[i] [/i]if you wish to use the witchy bathroom instead
[/list]
